note: Contract corpus only; no BAM raw sample data are included.

channel_profiles.description: Published current and voltage cadence 0.1 ms
Published robot TCP cadence 8 ms; file minimum 1 ms
Published control, power, gas and thermocouple cadence 1 ms

controls.mutation: Align process, robot and OPC-UA streams with distinct declared rates and explicit transforms.
controls.rationale: Positive known-answer verifies cadence preservation and deterministic membership.

controls.mutation: Unknown source clock is assigned the master clock by default.
controls.rationale: Clock domain identity must be explicit.

controls.mutation: Stream master clock differs from event clock.
controls.rationale: All event memberships share the declared master coordinate.

controls.mutation: Source SHA-256 is missing, malformed or zero.
controls.rationale: Receipts bind source evidence identity.

controls.mutation: Calibration/source digest link is mismatched or malformed.
controls.rationale: Source and calibration receipt digests must match.

controls.mutation: Timestamp lies outside clock-transform validity.
controls.rationale: Expired clock calibration is not extrapolated.

controls.mutation: Positive or negative drift sign/magnitude is applied incorrectly.
controls.rationale: Transforms must reproduce integer known answers.

controls.mutation: Drift uncertainty is omitted or does not grow with epoch distance.
controls.rationale: Clock uncertainty grows with elapsed source time.

controls.mutation: Common-clock declaration is treated as zero timing uncertainty.
controls.rationale: A shared clock is not a zero-uncertainty certificate.

controls.mutation: Sample timestamp uncertainty is missing or converted to zero.
controls.rationale: Unknown timing uncertainty is not zero.

controls.mutation: Affine integer time arithmetic wraps on overflow.
controls.rationale: Checked arithmetic rejects overflow.

controls.mutation: Affine clock slope is zero or negative.
controls.rationale: A non-monotonic clock transform is invalid.

controls.mutation: Duplicate sample sequence is silently accepted.
controls.rationale: Sequence identity must be unique.

controls.mutation: Sequence number regresses without discontinuity policy.
controls.rationale: Ordering is verified, not inferred from row order.

controls.mutation: Duplicate source timestamp is treated as another independent sample.
controls.rationale: Duplicate timestamp semantics must be resolved.

controls.mutation: Source timestamps regress despite increasing sequence.
controls.rationale: Event time is not replaced by sequence order.

controls.mutation: Missing timestamp is replaced by Unix epoch or zero.
controls.rationale: Missing timestamps remain missing.

controls.mutation: Missing receive time is assumed available at decision cutoff.
controls.rationale: Point-in-time availability requires receive time.

controls.mutation: Sample received after decision cutoff influences decision.
controls.rationale: Future information leakage is forbidden.

controls.mutation: Mapped event timestamp is after decision cutoff.
controls.rationale: A future event-time sample cannot support a past decision.

controls.mutation: Sample at event end is included in adjacent half-open windows.
controls.rationale: Half-open boundaries prevent double counting.

controls.mutation: Uncertainty envelope crossing pass boundary is arbitrarily assigned.
controls.rationale: Ambiguous membership abstains.

controls.mutation: Different stream cadences are coerced to one sample index or 0.1ms grid.
controls.rationale: A common clock does not imply a common sample cadence or index.

controls.mutation: 100ms OPC-UA value is held beyond its declared maximum age.
controls.rationale: Stale state is excluded, not held silently.

controls.mutation: Late arrival event time is replaced with receive time.
controls.rationale: Event time and ingestion time are distinct.

controls.mutation: Clipped, dropped or invalid values count as valid coverage.
controls.rationale: Only valid samples support coverage.

controls.mutation: Missing or dropped samples are interpolated by default.
controls.rationale: No sample fabrication or interpolation by default.

controls.mutation: Lead/lag is asserted below combined time uncertainty.
controls.rationale: Temporal resolvability is not causality.

controls.mutation: Sample from another WID, joint revision or pass is joined.
controls.rationale: Identity mismatch blocks cross-event joins.

controls.mutation: Event-edge gaps are hidden by high interior point count.
controls.rationale: Maximum gap includes event-window edges.

controls.mutation: Data received after a past decision are backdated into that decision.
controls.rationale: A decision may use only information received by its cutoff.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic integer-time and uncertainty contract only; not proof of hardware synchronization.
